prompt: A photo app stretches a picture taller by TRIPLING every height above the middle line. One point on the picture was $5$ units above the middle line. How many units above the middle line is it now?
hint: Stretching taller is the same as $3 \cdot f(x)$: every height gets multiplied.

hints.text: Stretching taller is the same as $3 \cdot f(x)$: every height gets multiplied.

explanation: A vertical stretch multiplies every $y$-value by the same number.

alternativeExplanations.title: Two points, one rule
steps: A point 1 unit up moves to 3 units up.
A point 2 units up moves to 6 units up.
The pattern is "times 3" every time, so 5 units up becomes 15 units up.
